module: Cisco ASR 1001 [1][K1], ASR 1002 [2][K2][E1 or E2], ASR1002-X [3][K2], ASR 1004 [4][K3][R1 or R2][E2, E3 or E4], ASR 1006 [5][K4][single or dual E2, E3, E4 or E5][dual R1 or R2] and ASR 1013 [6][K5][E4 or E5][R2]
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode and when tamper evident labels and security devices are installed on the initially built configuration as indicated in the Security Policy
description: The ASR 1000 Routers accelerate services by offering performance and resiliency with optimized, intelligent services; establishing a benchmark for price-to-performance offerings in the enterprise routing, service provider edge, and broadband aggregation segments; facilitating significant network innovations in areas such as secure WAN aggregation, managed customer-premises-equipment services, and service provider edge services, and reducing operating expenses and capital expenditures by facilitating managed or hosted services over identical architectures and operating environments.
hardware_versions: ASR1001 [1], ASR1002 [2], ASR1002-X [3], ASR1004 [4], ASR1006 [5] and ASR1013 [6]; FIPS KITs: ASR1001-FIPS-Kit [K1], ASR1002- FIPS-Kit [K2], ASR1004-FIPS-Kit [K3], ASR1006-FIPS-Kit [K4] and ASR1013-FIPS-Kit [K5]; Embedded Services Processors: ASR1000-ESP5 [E1], ASR1000-ESP10 [E2], ASR1000-ESP20 [E3], ASR1000-ESP40 [E4] and ASR1000-ESP100 [E5]; Route Processors: ASR-1000-RP1 [R1] and ASR-1000-RP2 [R2]

other_fields.Other Algorithms: DES; Diffie-Hellman (key agreement; key establishment methodology provides between 112 and 150 bits of encryption strength; non-compliant less than 112 bits of encryption strength); HMAC-MD5; IKE KDF; MD5; RC4; RSA (key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides 112 bits of encryption strength; non-compliant less than 112 bits of encryption strength); SHA-1 (non-compliant); SNMPv3 KDF; SSH KDF; TLS KDF
